name: ZX_REPORTING_TYPES_B
description: This table stores the tax reporting types, which identify specific units of information, such as a date or a text comment, to associate with a specific tax usage.

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Tax reporting type identifier

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Tax reporting type code

columns.name: REPORTING_TYPE_DATATYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate the data type of the reporting codes defined for this reporting type

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for which this reporting type is defined

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for which this reporting type is defined

columns.name: FORMAT_MASK
columns.description: Format mask to be applied on reporting codes of this reporting type

columns.name: MIN_LENGTH
columns.description: Column to store minimum length of reporting codes defined for this reporting type

columns.name: MAX_LENGTH
columns.description: Column to store maximum length of reporting codes defined for this reporting type

columns.name: LEGAL_MESSAGE_FLAG
columns.description: Not currently used

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: HAS_REPORTING_CODES_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether users can insert new reporting codes dynamically while associating them with taxes, statuses or rates

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: COUNTRY_CODE
columns.description: Country code for which this reporting type is defined.

columns.name: VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is based on an error or a warning.

columns.name: UNIQUENESS_VALIDATION_LEVEL
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether validation is for all parties or a specific party.

columns.name: VALIDATION_ROUTINE
columns.description: Identifier for the selected validation routine.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_TYPE
columns.description: Registration type code associated with reporting type.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: MODULE_ID
columns.description: Seed Data Framework: indicates the module that owns the row. A module is an entry in Application Taxonomy such as a Logical Business Area. When the MODULE_ID column exists and the owner of the row is not specified, then the Seed Data Framework will not extract the row as seed data.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
